Send(...)' branch. Documentation 4's timetable is reproduced with aligned columns (rows 7–13 empty as printed); the blank answer lines of Documentation 5, 7 and 8 are omitted. In the archive the source is landscape; Documentation 4 notes it should be printed in portrait mode.
